source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

This is precisely the direction I hoped we would take.

I feel we have now established the brand's architectural language, and I’m excited to see how it works across the full VELLVÉ wordmark.

Before you start, one thought came to mind. Over the course of this process, we naturally gravitated toward an all-caps wordmark, but I realized that I never made that choice consciously; it simply emerged as we developed the hero V. My instinct remains that all caps is the correct direction because I love the architectural rhythm it produces, particularly with the hero V at the beginning of the word.

I’d like to pursue that approach first. After seeing the complete wordmark together, we can certainly explore another case treatment if we discover a compelling reason to do so. However, I think our first priority should be to see the architectural vision we have spent months developing come together as a complete identity.

I’m very excited to see the first VELLVÉ wordmark.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

Following our conversation about the unified architectural language and the all-caps approach, I’m pleased to share the first full integration of the VELLVÉ wordmark.

This layout shows our approved "Anchor V" establishing the beginning of the identity through its sturdy stance and confident sweep. That proprietary logic also carries into the É accent, turning it into an unshakeable signature.

With the complete architectural vision now visible together, my central priority is refining the balance of the internal letters (E, L, L). I’m actively developing the "optical rhythm" by adjusting both the kerning (spacing) and character widths, ensuring that the eye travels smoothly through the word without disruption.

This represents a genuine milestone for the Vellvé identity, and I’m excited to hear your response to this first view of the complete brand

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports producing the first complete VELLVÉ wordmark using the agreed all-caps approach.
